public.title: Remove Nth Node From End of List
public.description: values encodes a singly linked list in head-to-tail order. Remove the nth node counted from the tail (n=1 removes the last node). Return the remaining values in head-to-tail order. There are 1 to 1000 integers from -10000 to 10000, and n is 1 through list length.
hints: Convert the tail-based position to a zero-based head index.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Array index length minus n identifies the removed logical node. Copy every other element. O(n) time and output space; node identity is outside this JSON adaptation.
